thresholds.rule: maximum of relative and absolute margin
thresholds.aggregation: median of per-process percentiles; all ten pairs retained

timeline.measurement: injected GPUI input to current Metal draw, excludes compositor

interaction.measurement: native pointer to both current Metal surfaces, excludes compositor; batch admission precedes timer

post_benchmark_change.description: Handle explicit Quit rejection by an attached peer without recursively retrying; outside every timed input/render path; focused and full native regression rerun.
